_comment: C0-9 正文英译 · sentry-mcp（2026-10-25）。无 extraSections（内置五节由 axes/leads/runs/unknowns/related 承载）。

axes.model_access:
**It calls no model itself** — an interface implementation called by MCP clients; choosing the model is the client's business.
It wraps Sentry platform capabilities (issues, events, releases, alerts) as MCP tools for agents to query and diagnose.
axes.runtime:
Mainly the official hosted remote server (mcp.sentry.dev direct fetch 200); the getsentry/toolkit repo is the official tooling line
(936★, last push 2026-10-21, GitHub API verified). The old repo name getsentry/sentry-mcp now redirects (seen in the direct fetch).
axes.local_files:
Never touches the local file system — it operates on Sentry cloud data (issues/events/releases).
Local logs and source code are outside its scope; reading local files requires pairing a filesystem server.
axes.background:
The hosted form is independent of the client process; the service lives on Sentry's side; no resume-from-checkpoint semantics —
the MCP session model is request-response, the official side provides no background-task mechanism.
axes.tools:
A toolset aimed at "agents checking crashes/diagnosing production issues": whoami, find issues, view issue details,
events and stacks, release comparisons, etc.; the complete tool inventory follows the official docs, not enumerated item by item.
axes.context:
No cross-session memory — each session is independent, state lives in the Sentry platform itself.
The official side provides no server-side memory or retrieval layer (not verified ≠ absent; docs checked showed none).
axes.permissions:
Permissions are determined by Sentry account auth (OAuth login flow); it can read issue and event data,
the write surface (e.g. resolving issues) follows the official tool inventory — write-capability boundaries not verified item by item.
axes.fit:
Fits: coding agents directly asking "does this error exist in Sentry", hooking production-incident diagnosis into agent workflows.
Not a fit: local log analysis (out of scope); closed-source commercial integrations during the FSL restriction window (read the license terms first).

mcp.auth:
Goes through the Sentry account OAuth login flow (browser authorization); no official docs for a plaintext-PAT configuration route —
not verified item by item. Credential storage and rotation details are not expanded in the official docs.
mcp.scope:
Scope = the org/project data visible to the Sentry account; reading issues/events is primary.
The write operations and high-risk tool inventory not verified item by item; no official docs for a separate approval mechanism.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/mcp/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/mcp/_protocol.md).
unknowns:
- The complete tool inventory and write-operation boundaries (not enumerated item by item)
- SSE transport support status (not verified item by item)
- The change date of each FSL version (not verified item by item — check the current LICENSE.md terms before use)
related: Both vendor-official remote servers: the GitHub version has a wide tool surface with complete write capabilities, the Sentry version is primarily read-diagnosis.
